brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished four residential structures in the Bir al-Maskub Bedouin community east of occupied Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolitions also included solar panels, rooms and bathrooms. The forces issued demolition notices against five additional structures in the area.

The demolitions occur amid escalating targeting of Palestinian structures and communities east of Jerusalem, according to the report.

title: Israeli forces demolish four homes in Bedouin community east of Jerusalem
